content.short: Echidna is a fuzzing and property-based testing tool for Ethereum smart contracts.
content.description: Echidna is a fuzzing and property-based testing tool for Ethereum smart contracts. Rather than simply hunting for crashes, it aims to falsify user-defined invariants (properties) to reveal logical defects. The toolset allows writing custom analyses for evaluating complex contracts and systematically exploring their state transitions. While focused on EVM bytecode, Echidna uses a property-based fuzzing approach to stress test contracts across inputs and sequences of calls. Echidna was developed by Trail of Bits, a security solutions company.
